phone.changelog: v3.3.48: Movies fixed — movibox streams routed through VPS proxy (CDN rejects headerless video requests).

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.89: Search results now scroll vertically through every result (the results grid was a nested scroller the remote couldn't scroll — only one row was ever visible). Settings page opens at the top with the full Connect Your Phone card + working QR code (the old QR image host is dead, replaced). Settings pill sits fully inside the nav capsule. Movies/Series genre chips now render (TMDB genre ids were dropped). Addon URL input is remote-reachable.
